title: French Hazelnut Granola
description: A crunchy and nutty granola made with hazelnuts and a touch of French flair, perfect for snacking or as a topping for your favorite yogurt or oatmeal.
instructions: Mix together chopped hazelnuts, rolled oats, cubed French bread, and yellowed sugar in a large bowl.
Drizzle coconut oil over the mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Spread the mixture out onto a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from oven and let cool completely before breaking into pieces.
Serve as a snack or use as a topping for your favorite yogurt or oatmeal.
